gen_text: The system shall allow only users holding the accountant role to confirm or reject a payment, and shall reject the same request from any other user.
The profile shall store a name, an address and a phone number (REQ-F-01) and may store at most one bank account (REQ-F-02).
All stored attributes are mandatory except the bank account (REQ-F-45).
Each product shall have a name, description, price and image (REQ-F-03) stored as decimal for price (REQ-F-46).
All product attributes are mandatory (REQ-F-45).
Given a product creation request with valid data, when the system stores the product, then the product becomes available for order items.
An order shall reference exactly one known customer (REQ-F-08) and contain at least one order item (REQ-F-15).
Every order item shall refer to an existing product (REQ-F-16) and store quantity, unit price and a reference to exactly one product (REQ-F-06).

Given a valid order submission, when the system records the order date as the submission date and computes the total amount as Σ(quantity × unit price) (REQ-F-17), then the order status is set to submitted.
Given an order submission where the customer is unknown, when the system validates the request, then the order is rejected and no record is created (REQ-F-14).
Given an order submission containing a non‑existent product, when the system validates the items, then the order is rejected and no record is created (REQ-F-16).
The status of an order may change from submitted to pending only (REQ-F-49).
Given an order with status submitted, when OrderStaff selects “receive”, then the order status becomes pending (REQ-F-18).
Status may change from pending to filled only (REQ-F-49).
Given a pending order, when OrderStaff selects “fill”, then the order status becomes filled (REQ-F-20).
Given a pending order, when OrderStaff selects “decline”, then the order status becomes closed (REQ-F-22).
Status may change from filled to shipped only (REQ-F-49).
Given a filled order, when OrderStaff selects “ship”, then the order status becomes shipped (REQ-F-25).
An invoice may be created only for orders with status filled or shipped (REQ-F-28) and only if the order does not already have an invoice (REQ-F-29).
Invoice status is initially issued (REQ-F-28) and may change only to paid (REQ-F-50).
Given an eligible order, when Accountant creates the invoice with date, amount, payment method, then the invoice is linked to the order and its status is issued.
Given an order that is declined, when Accountant attempts to raise an invoice, then the request is rejected (REQ-F-24).
Given an order whose status is submitted, pending or closed, when Accountant attempts to raise an invoice, then the request is rejected (REQ-F-30).
Payments may be recorded only against invoices with status issued (REQ-F-32) and the payment status starts as pending (REQ-F-35).
Given a failed payment, when a further payment is submitted, then the new payment is created with status pending while the failed one remains failed (REQ-F-34).
Given a pending payment, when Accountant confirms it, then the payment status becomes completed (REQ-F-35) and the invoice status becomes paid (REQ-F-36).
An order may change from shipped to closed only when its linked invoice status is paid (REQ-F-40).
Given a shipped order with a paid invoice, when OrderStaff selects “close”, then the order status becomes closed (REQ-F-40).
Given an order whose invoice is paid but whose status is not shipped, when OrderStaff attempts to close it, then the request is rejected (REQ-F-42).
Once an order reaches status closed it never changes again (REQ-F-44).
